correspondences.notes: BIDS micr needs OME-Zarr (.ome.zarr/); plain Zarr v3 qualifies only with OME-NGFF 0.5 metadata.

brainlife.desc: Zarr v3 store root metadata (zarr.json) for a deskewed light-sheet volume, from the APEX hackathon TIFF-to-Zarr App.
brainlife.name: zarr v3
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Recording the Zarr v3 output of light-sheet deskewing.

**Not for:** Analysis Apps; only zarr.json is registered, the chunks are written elsewhere.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** output of 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/zarr_v3.json

identifying_risks: Specimen IDs in Zarr attributes may link to a donor.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 2: human status depends on the specimen; participant-level tissue images carry no direct identifiers (Tier 2), non-human data is Tier 1.
sharing_cautions: Confirm species and donor consent terms before sharing human tissue images.
tier_conditions: Tier 1 when the specimen is non-human (e.g. mouse) or synthetic.
Tier 2 for human tissue linked to a donor or specimen code.

intended_use: Recording the Zarr v3 output of light-sheet deskewing.
not_suitable_for: Analysis Apps; only zarr.json is registered, the chunks are written elsewhere.

outputs_of.name: Convert_Tiff_to_Zarr3
outputs_of.purpose: deskewed Zarr v3 volume (written by a cluster job)
